comparison.objective: Set coarse and fine sliding weights until a beam-scale pointer balances; candidate positions and secures two proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Notched coarse adjustment and continuous fine sliding using balance feedback versus partial screw release, sensor sliding, holding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Scale reading must be within 20 g with the pointer floating and weights still for 1 second; candidate needs two ≤6 mm over-center states retained 3 seconds.
comparison.reason: Both use feedback-guided sliding, but the scale tests iterative balancing of free weights and has no fastening or retention under tightening. Candidate indicator hysteresis and allowable tightening drift are unspecified.
